metadata.description: Code-rendered music-video skills adapted for Chinese lyrics and Windows laptops: painted watercolour MVs (p5.brush) and three.js kinetic lyric MVs.

plugins.name: painted-mv
plugins.description: Hand-painted watercolour-and-ink music videos and cartoons (p5.js + p5.brush, headless Chrome, ffmpeg) from a song and its Chinese lyrics: beat grid, lyric alignment, storyboard, per-chapter painting, contact-sheet review, brush-font karaoke.

plugins.name: kinetic-lyric-mv
plugins.description: Beat-synced kinetic-typography lyric music videos with a three.js/WebGL engine (pdoom-video style): per-character Chinese type, bloom, grain, motion blur; low-spec 720p profile for integrated GPUs.
